run_train_main: run the BrainMagick training pipeline with Hydra config for MEG brain signal encoding or decoding tasks
get_solver: build a Solver with datasets, ConvRNN or SimpleConv model, optional DeepMel feature model, and Adam optimizer
model_hash: create a SHA1 hash string from a PyTorch model parameters for tracking and reproducibility
override_args: refactor Hydra config args to resolve events_filter references and convert cache paths to absolute
run_training_loop: run the training loop via Solver.train or display model architecture and parameter count in MB
